name: Heart Attack
description: Random chance to die of a heart attack.

enabled.name: Enable heart attacks
enabled.description: Toggle ON to enable heart attacks.

hac.name: Heart attack chance
hac.description: The percentage chance that the player dies of a heart attack. Setting this to 0 essentially disables the mod.

lowrange.name: Low Percentage Range
lowrange.description: The low end of the range players can die within. Players will not die of a heart attack before this percentage.

highrange.name: High Percentage Range
highrange.description: The high end of the range players can die within. Players will not die of a heart attack after this percentage.
